posts.description:
Pujo is a time for good food, good company, and a little extra reason to celebrate. We’re bringing something new to the table this season. 😌✨

Gondhoraj Spritzer, Iced Jaggery Latte, Peri Peri Tofu Bites, Peri Peri Chicken Bites, Pesto Meatballs on Toast, and Mishti Doi Tart — crafted especially for Kolkata, now serving this Pujo. 💙

#bluetokaiinkolkata #pujoseason #kolkatamenulaunch #bluetokaibrews #durgapujavibes

This October, we’re reading about sisterhood in all its forms — bonds that weather change, and women finding strength, comfort, and courage in one another.

Our friends at Bahrisons in Delhi and Hyderabad, Atta Galatta in Bengaluru, and Pagdandi in Pune are sharing their picks for the month.

Reading along? Tell us in the comments about a book that made you think of the women in your life, or tag us in your current read with #BTBookClub.

Specialty coffee can sometimes feel like it comes with a few too many rules. 

We’ve always wanted to make it more inviting, leave plenty of room to experiment, and help you find what tastes good to you. 

This International Coffee Day, leave the rules behind and have some fun with your coffee. ☕

#internationalcoffeeday #bluetokaicoffeeroasters #specialtycoffee #losetherecipe #havefunwithcoffee

The city’s getting ready, and so are we. ✨

Kolkata, come by and savour flavours inspired by a city in celebration. We’ve put together a few special treats just for Pujo, and can’t wait to share them with you and your loved ones.

See you around the table!

#bluetokaiinkolkata #kolkatacoffee #prepujovibes #calcuttacoffeeculture #festiveseasonvibes

October is bringing eight more stories, questions, and rabbit holes to Grounds for Thought.

We’ll get into parenting in the age of AI, why we buy what we buy, the story of India’s Constitution, what the body of a goddess can tell us about touch — and four more conversations waiting to be unpacked.

Eight lectures. Two cities. One more month of asking better questions.

summary.snippet: "Service is good here so cafe lovers can surely check this place out."
"Quality coffee, serene atmosphere, polite and friendly staff."
"They were really soft and the filling inside tasted good."

most_relevant.description: We ordered Vietnamese Iced Coffee which has been always good. Then we ordered Classic Chocolate Cake which was okay.

The food served tasted very old, the Bagel seemed at least 12 to 14 days old, so did the marble cake also seemed older. Dry and the smell of old bread. The servers seemed cold and not very responsive.  They need to improve in both customer relations and food quality. Name made will help them if don't maintain the good service and product.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Have visited Blue Tokai multiple times, and their Vietnamese Iced Coffee is absolutely awesome! The taste is consistently rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced every single time.

Great place to relax with a refreshing coffee. Highly recommended for all coffee lovers! ☕️👌

Special thanks to Miss Hoorya and I ordered a cappuccino, and it was absolutely perfect. Smooth, rich, and at the ideal temperature. You can tell they actually care about the quality of their beans. Very welcoming atmosphere

I placed an order for country sourdough at 8:30 pm on 3rd August. Received a loaf that expires on 4th August. Asked Vasudev from blue tokai to replace it with a fresher batch and his response is to simply use it past expiry by keeping in fridge. Else i have to visit store to exchange with fresh loaf because they don’t have any delivery person

This place used to be my favorite. Great peaceful ambience good service good food as well.
However offlate with the surge of online order the service to folks who come to the cafe are not priortised at all. In cafe orders take a minimum of 20 mins , neglect towards minor aspects like tissues or cutlery or glasses etc. I dont blame the staff cause they have too much to manage with online and cafe orders
Hence to the management do request to look into the matter if you would still like customers to drop by your cafe or should we also place online orders.

Had Good and delicious vanilla bean hot  latte. good place for family and friends chill out .
Good amphibians and friendly and helpfull staffs at indiranagar Blue tokai highly recommended.🥳

They serve you the Avocado Feta Sando with practically no Feta and the barest trace  elements of Avocado. You're essentially paying for cucumber tomatoes lettuce and milk bread.
Home made sandwiches would score higher than what I got.
The iced Latte with date syrup was fine.
Will not be going back though...sorry!
